---

**Minecraft, mod, and loader versions**
Please list the minecraft version, mod version, mod loader (fabric/forge/neoforge), and mod loader version at the top of your report.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is, including if the bug occurs even when the only mods installed are Additional Placements and its requirements.

**To Reproduce**
if you need to take specific actions to encounter the bug, list them here.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**mod list**
If you are using additional mods, and the bug only occurs when the mods are installed, please attach a list of your current mods to the bottom of the bug report.
